## GSE130435 -- only a processed count matrix

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
```

```{r}
GSE130435 <- read.delim("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE130435_RAW/GSE130435_1904_processed_data_raw_counts_juliavallve.txt")

# Map Ensembl Gene IDs to Gene Names
gene_names <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = GSE130435$ID, column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL")

# Add the gene names to the dataframe
GSE130435$gene_name <- gene_names
```

### Save object
```{r}
write.csv(GSE130435, file = "~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE130435_RAW/cleaned_GSE130435_EuE_macrophages.csv")
```
